# PCafe 2025 - IoT Website Replacement Project

PCafe 2025 is a comprehensive website replacement project that migrates from Django to a modern Go + React architecture. The project serves IoT engineers and visitors with event management, blog functionality, and sophisticated IoT data visualization capabilities.

## Project Overview

**Purpose**: Replace existing Django-based website with Go backend + React frontend to improve maintainability, scalability, and performance.

**Target Users**:
- General visitors (IoT engineers, facility tour candidates)
- Single administrator for content management

**Core Features**:
- Event calendar with automated data extraction from URLs/images/PDFs
- IoT time-series data visualization (50M+ records)
- Blog system with Markdown/HTML support
- Contact form with Cloudflare Turnstile protection
- Admin dashboard using React Admin

## Technology Stack

### Backend (Go)
- **Framework**: Gin (github.com/gin-gonic/gin)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15+ with TimescaleDB extension for time-series data
- **ORM**: GORM (gorm.io/gorm)
- **Authentication**: Session-based with secure cookies (no JWT)
- **Documentation**: Swagger UI at `/docs` (admin-only)
- **Security**: bcrypt password hashing, Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA

### Frontend (React/TypeScript)
- **Build Tool**: Vite
- **UI Framework**: React 18 with TypeScript
- **Routing**: React Router v7
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit + Redux Saga
- **UI Components**: Radix UI primitives
- **Styling**: CSS Modules
- **Charts**: Chart.js + D3.js for IoT data visualization
- **Admin Interface**: React Admin with custom components
- **Development Port**: 4000

### Database Architecture
- **Primary DB**: PostgreSQL with GORM models
- **Time-Series**: TimescaleDB hypertables for IoT data
- **Partitioning**: Time-based partitioning with 1-day intervals
- **Optimization**: Continuous aggregates, compression, retention policies
- **Performance**: Indexes optimized for time-range queries

## Project Structure

```
/
├── backend/           # Go REST API server
│   ├── main.go       # Application entry point
│   ├── handlers/     # HTTP request handlers (auth, blog, events, iot, contact)
│   ├── models/       # GORM database models
│   ├── services/     # Business logic (OCR, metadata extraction, email)
│   ├── middleware/   # Authentication and CORS middleware
│   ├── db/          # Database connections, migrations, seeds
│   └── docs/        # Swagger documentation
├── frontend/         # React TypeScript application
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/  # Reusable UI components
│   │   ├── pages/      # Page components (Home, Events, Blog, Graphs, Contact)
│   │   ├── admin/      # React Admin configuration
│   │   ├── store/      # Redux store with slices and sagas
│   │   ├── services/   # API client functions
│   │   └── types/      # TypeScript definitions
│   └── public/        # Static assets
├── CLAUDE.md         # Development guidelines and project documentation  
├── Makefile          # Development commands
└── docker-compose.yml # Local development setup
```

## Key Components

### Backend Models (GORM)
- **User**: Admin authentication with session management
- **Session**: Cookie-based session storage
- **Event**: Event management with metadata extraction capabilities
- **BlogPost**: Blog articles with Markdown/HTML support
- **ContactSubmission**: Contact form with Turnstile verification
- **IoTData**: TimescaleDB hypertable for sensor data (temperature, CO2, power, etc.)
- **SanjoTsubameCalendar**: External calendar integration

### Frontend Features
- **HomePage**: Landing page with latest news and events
- **EventsPage**: Calendar view with event management
- **BlogPage**: Article listing and detail views
- **GraphsPage**: IoT data visualization with zoom/pan capabilities
- **ContactPage**: Contact form with spam protection
- **Admin Dashboard**: React Admin interface for content management

### API Architecture
All endpoints follow `/api/{resource}` pattern:
- `GET/POST /api/auth/*` - Authentication endpoints
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/events/*` - Event management
- `GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/blog/*` - Blog management  
- `GET /api/iot/*` - IoT data queries with time-range filtering
- `POST /api/contact` - Contact form submission
- `GET /api/sanjo-tsubame-calendar/*` - External calendar integration

### IoT Data Structure
**Device Types**: Temperature sensors (1F lobby, 2F office), power meters, environmental sensors
**Sensor Types**: temperature (°C), humidity (%), power_consumption (kWh), voltage (V), current (A)
**Data Quality**: good (95%), warning (5%), error (rare)
**Storage**: TimescaleDB hypertables with automatic partitioning and compression

## Development Workflow

### Setup Commands
```bash
make setup          # Install all dependencies
make dev            # Start both backend and frontend servers
make build          # Build both components
make test           # Run all tests
make lint           # Lint all code
```

### Database Operations
```bash
make db-up          # Start PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB
make db-migrate     # Run database migrations
make db-seed        # Populate with development data
```

### Quality Assurance
Pre-commit requirements:
- Go: `go fmt`, `go vet`, `go test`
- Frontend: `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, `bun run build`
- Documentation: `markdownlint **/*.md`

## Security Considerations
- Session-based authentication with secure HTTP-only cookies
- CORS configuration for frontend-backend communication
- SQL injection protection via GORM parameterized queries
- Input validation on all endpoints
- Cloudflare Turnstile for contact form spam protection
- Admin-only endpoints protected by authentication middleware

## Performance Optimizations
- TimescaleDB continuous aggregates for statistical queries
- Database indexes optimized for time-range and device filtering
- Frontend code splitting with Vite
- Chart.js for efficient data visualization
- Redux Saga for async state management

## Environment Configuration
Required environment variables:
- Database: `DB_HOST`, `DB_PORT`, `DB_NAME`, `DB_USER`, `DB_PASSWORD`
- Server: `SERVER_PORT`, `ENV`
- Security: `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`, `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY`

## Deployment
- **Local Development**: Docker Compose setup
- **Production**: Direct Go binary execution on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (Sakura Internet VPS)
- **Static Assets**: React build served by Go server
- **HTTPS**: Let's Encrypt integration

This project demonstrates modern full-stack development practices with emphasis on IoT data handling, responsive design, and maintainable architecture.
